howThisRepairWasScoped.claimScoping: THE BOUND IS THE CLAIM. This census claims: within the reach of the five published predicate families, every candidate was read at sentence level and classified below, and exactly one carried a falsified verification status -- the leaf this operation repairs. It does NOT claim zero falsified carriers exist under spellings outside that reach; B-EIR7-01 and B-EIR8-01 were both found one spelling outside the previous sweep, and a finite vocabulary cannot close an open spelling space. A successor extending the vocabulary further should expect new candidates and should scope its own claim the same way.
